description: Department of National Physical Planning - Declare that shrine of our Lady of Madhu as a Sacred Place
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters. It is an order under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance declaring a specific area of land (the Shrine of Our Lady of Madhu) as an Urban Development Area and directing the preparation of a physical plan. The content includes detailed land descriptions, survey information, boundary coordinates, and specific land measurements (121.4677 hectares), which are characteristic of land gazettes. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the land declaration purpose and does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
